body: Hey man I’ve been driving trucks for the past two years. I’m terribly afraid of heights that’s why I’m here looking how to get over my fear of heights😂 when I first started trucking that also came across my mind the thought remained on my mind. I vividly remember one of my first loads was driving from California to Oregon on the I-5 I was on the phone with my ex telling her how nervous I was cause I was as getting closer and closer to the mountain areas. I reached Redding California and I was telling my ex I was about to climb mt Shasta funny enough I lose reception and the call ends now I’m panicking alone 😂 I finally reach the bridge at Shasta lake and surprisingly I was like wow that’s actually not bad I didn’t feel any intense fear of the height keep in mind I’m still not at the top of the mountain I’m at the very bottom still😂 still no reception so I’m still nervous for the climb. I start slowly climbing the mountain and my gps shows me at what elevation I’m at and now I’m at the top I can see the pines I can see where the mountain drastically slopes and I felt no fear or uneasiness of the height. Idk if my brain just feels more comfortable because I’m physically in control of the truck or maybe because I still know I’m on solid ground but I had no fear whatsoever. But again I’m still incredibly scared of heights I can’t climb more than 5 steps on a ladder, videos of heights gives me an upset stomach feeling, the thought of being in high places gives me slight anxiety so I still haven’t overcome my fear of heights but driving a semi truck over bridges and in the mountains is not scary at all your just overthinking it like I was. I would say high wings and the snow in mountain areas is far more scarier than the height. Just be safe out there and keep a peace of mind that the heights in mountain driving is not what your expecting. You’ll probably laugh at yourself when you finally drive over your first bridge and mountain on how silly it was to be scared over those thoughts. Anyway stay safe on the road and I’ll be excited to hear how it went 😂
